description: Nothing has revealed its Flipkart Big Billion Days sale offers across its smartphones, audio products, smartwatches and charging accessories. The Phone (4a) series and Phone (4b) will receive price cuts, bank offers and exchange benefits on select variants, with effective prices starting at Rs. 27,999. The sale will also lower prices of products including the Nothing Headphone (1), Ear Open, CMF Headphone Pro and CMF Watch 3 Pro. Flipkart Plus, VIP, Black and eligible cardholders will get early access from October 8.
title: Nothing Deals Revealed for Phone 4 Series, CMF Buds Lineup, More Ahead of Flipkart's Big Billion Days Sale

description: Big-battery smartphones are becoming increasingly popular because of the ongoing memory crisis, which is driving smartphone costs higher.  Manufacturers have taken various cost-cutting measures, like reducing RAM and opting for fewer cameras. But one area they haven’t compromised is battery life. We take a closer look at the best big-battery smartphones under Rs. 30,000 in India.
title: Best Phones Under Rs. 30,000 in India to Buy During Amazon, Flipkart Sale: Poco X8, OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite and More

description: Smartphone prices are rising across India and other global markets due to the increasing memory and component costs. Still, many handsets sold by leading brands like OnePlus, Redmi, Motorola, and Realme, priced below Rs. 30,000 in India, now offer 256GB of onboard storage. They also come with batteries, high-refresh-rate displays and capable mid-range chipsets. Our selection of phones with 256GB storage includes the Realme P4 Power 5G, Redmi Note 15 SE 5G, Motorola Edge 70 Fusion, Vivo T5 Lite 5G and OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite.
title: Best Phones With 256GB Storage Under Rs. 30,000 in India: Vivo T5 Lite 5G, Redmi Note 15 SE 5G, More

description: Finding a smartphone that lasts can come down to manufacturer-tested durability ratings. But long-term software support has always been a constant problem. Thankfully, manufacturers have started sharing these details, and buyers can now make an informed choice. In a sea of smartphones, across budgets, which ones offer the best software support? Read on to find out.
title: Best Phones for Long-Term Use in India: Apple iPhone 17, Google Pixel 10a and More

description: The Dell 14 Plus 2-in-1 combines AMD Ryzen AI 7 350 performance with a 360-degree hinge, touchscreen and stylus support. Its comfortable keyboard, solid build and dependable battery make it well suited to everyday work, while Tent mode adds some genuinely useful flexibility. However, the 14-inch FHD+ display is let down by limited brightness and colour coverage, and the Radeon 860M is not suited to demanding graphics work. At around Rs. 90,000, the Dell faces strong competition from OLED-equipped alternatives.
title: Dell 14 Plus 2-in-1 Review: A Convertible Worth Considering?

description: The Vivo V80 is all set to be launched in India as the latest addition to the company’s V-series lineup. The successor to the Vivo V70 is likely to arrive as the first model in the Vivo V80 series. In the days leading up to its launch, several details about the upcoming handset have been teased. The Vivo V80 is confirmed to sport a 1.5K 144Hz display. It will ship with Android 17-based OriginOS 7 and pack a 7,000mAh-class battery.
title: Vivo V80 Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price in India, Features, Specifications and More
